title: AV metadata hints on attachments (adopt later, decision mimid-1wgh.44.46)
description: Mark 2026-11-16: adopt draft-mahy-mimi-av-metadata-02 with mimid's attachment support. (1) mimi-content: typed codec for content extension key 6 (part_index, type, width, height, duration ms, preview_index, accessibility_text, rotation); part_index must name a SinglePart or ExternalPart (content-10 part index, txt L751-754). Note the draft's CDDL uses a text key "av_metadata" while IANA asks for integer 6 (wg bead mimid-1wgh.44.47): follow the integer. (2) JMAP projection: width, height, duration and alt text onto attachment fields. Sender values are claims: no allocation from them.
